description: This file defines a React functional component 'Panel' that manages routing and initial data fetching for a user panel in a web application. It handles token validation, conditional rendering of a loader, and sets up various routes for different sections of the user panel.

methods.name: Panel
methods.description: React functional component that manages user panel routing, token validation, and initial data loading.

methods.description: Asynchronously verifies the user's token validity, updates authentication status, and fetches initial data if valid.
